name: Geth RETURNDATA consensus split
rootCause: A crafted transaction exploited CVE-2021-39137, where Geth could corrupt RETURNDATA after a datacopy precompile call. Unpatched Geth nodes forked away from patched nodes and other clients; client diversity limited the damage.
